task.title: Keep a cookie in a file

step.cmd: Delete any sessions_ptxt.txt that an earlier run left in the output folder.
Sign in at the sign-in page. The server sets the sessions_ptxt cookie.
Save the sessions_ptxt cookie to sessions_ptxt.txt.
Sign out at the sign-out page, which replaces the cookie.
Open the cookie report, and check that it shows sessions_ptxt=signed-in.
